issue.body:
- **Kind:** `change`. The maker is `engineer`.
- **Judges:** `reviewer` and `architect`, each on `codex` whoever the maker is (`rigger.config.mjs`, `kinds.change`; `src/workflow/gate.mjs` requires every judge the kind names).
- **Owner marker:** needed if the work edits a Self-hosting path this card may touch (see "Self-hosting paths" below; `AGENTS.md`, "Self-hosting" and "Review and merge"; `D25` rules 5 and 7).
- **Branch:** `rigger-1302` (`rigger.config.mjs`, `worktrees.topic`).
- **Wave 1.** Not dispatched until an architect who is not its maker has attacked this acceptance ([M8-K4](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1293#issuecomment-6731122016)), and its edge E5 is ruled in [M8-K5](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1293#issuecomment-6731270738).
- **Time:** about 3 hours of maker work. A judgment, not a measurement.

Part of **M8**, Phase A. **Author:** the PM, under [M8-U2](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1293#issuecomment-6731116523), which ratified [outline r3](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1293#issuecomment-6731093824) together with the architect's review [1293#6731014328](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1293#issuecomment-6731014328) (§1 M8-05).

Read at `origin/main` `52fb8a3d`.

---

**The gap.** Two rows are counted gaps (`D17`):

- `R-CARD-1`: "A card states its acceptance — what done means — before any work on it starts." Its `checked by` is "the engine, at admission".
- `R-ESCALATE-5`: "A kind of work naming the owner as its last judge is the loop running, not an escalation." Its `checked by` is "the event record, by owner dispatches against escalations".

**Placement** (the architect's review §1). `R-CARD-1`'s "at admission" is L2's acceptance form check (`src/workflow/form-check.mjs`), not L3's admission directory. `R-ESCALATE-5` is L2's routing plus L5's escalation-rate derivation ("What `report` derives", L2's section).

**Measured at `52fb8a3d`.** `sh test/suite.sh test/form-check.test.mjs` (with five other files, through the suite slot): 302 tests, 302 pass, 0 fail. `docs/derived/test-matrix.md` lists `R-CARD-7`'s tests, among them:

- "plan prints a card with no acceptance with missing acceptance as the reason, and does not pull it";
- "once, given a ready card L2 refuses, names the card and the reason";
- "run, given a ready card L2 refuses, names the card and the reason".

Whether those runs also leave no claim, no worktree and no dispatch is not asserted there. Establishing it is this card's work.

**Evidence routes.** Every test runs in the deterministic tier against the fake forge the suite already uses, in the maker's workspace. A new test file runs under the strict deterministic guard, which lets it start only `git` and `tar` (`test/suite-guard.cjs`), so it cannot drive `once` or `run` as a subprocess, nor reach a dispatch. The `once` and `run` rows of Table C therefore go into `test/once.test.mjs` and `test/run.test.mjs`, which are on `test/suite.sh`'s converting list. The new files hold the `plan` rows, driven in-process through `test/in-process-entry.mjs`, and Table E, driven in-process as `test/failed-maker.test.mjs` drives `loop` (pre-dispatch attack, [1302#6731416965](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1302#issuecomment-6731416965), finding 2).

- **Claims:** `R-CARD-1`, `R-ESCALATE-5`.
- **Lands in:**
  - `test/acceptance-first.test.mjs` and `test/owner-turn.test.mjs`, new tests, for the `plan` rows of Table C and for Table E;
  - `test/once.test.mjs` and `test/run.test.mjs`, new tests appended, for the `once` and `run` rows of Table C;
  - new fixture modules under `test/`, if the maker writes a shared fixture;
  - `src/workflow/form-check.mjs`, `src/workflow/next-action.mjs`, `src/workflow/judges.mjs`, `src/workflow/escalation.mjs` and `src/observation/report.mjs`, only if a row fails;
  - `src/workflow/transitions.mjs`, where `review.escalate` is emitted, only if row E2 fails;
  - `src/scheduling/loop.mjs`, only if a Table C row fails because L3 takes a claim before reading L2's refusal;
  - `docs/derived/test-matrix.md`, regenerated by `npm run matrix`, never hand-edited (`D8`);
  - one journal entry, `docs/journal/<date>-<time>-<card>-acceptance-first-owner-turn.md`.
- **Binding document:** none.
- **Self-hosting paths:** this card may touch `src/workflow/form-check.mjs`, `src/workflow/next-action.mjs`, `src/workflow/judges.mjs` and `src/workflow/escalation.mjs`; touching any of them means an owner marker. `src/observation/report.mjs`, `src/workflow/transitions.mjs` and `src/scheduling/loop.mjs` are not. `src/scheduling/admission.mjs` is not in this card's scope.
- **Grant classes:** none. No existing line under `test/` changes.
- **Test-first exception:** a claiming test that passes at the merge base is admitted without a red run. Each such test is named in a quoted guarded mutation under the `tdd` skill's "A mutation claim", with killed `npm run mutation:receipt` output, whose mutation turns it red. One receipt may cover several tests.
- **Clocks:** every new test that drives `once`, `run` or `loop`, or times anything, injects `manualClock` from `test/clock-report-world.mjs`. Every new test passes #1137's guard, and #1138's check if it has merged. `src/cli/plan.mjs` takes no clock, so a `plan` test injects none.
- **Settings:** none.

**Table C: a Ready card the form check refuses.** The refusal shapes are the reasons `R-CARD-7` and `R-CARD-8` give. Each shape is run through each verb.

| # | The card's body | Verbs | Required outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | no `Acceptance` heading outside a fence | `plan`, `once`, `run` | for `plan`: no pull line for the card, and the card named with its refusal reason; for `once` and `run`: no `pull` event for the card, no move of the card out of Ready, no worktree, no `dispatch.start` for it |
| C2 | an `Acceptance` section holding only task-list items | `plan`, `once`, `run` | as C1 |
| C3 | an `Acceptance` section whose only bullets are inside a fence | `plan`, `once`, `run` | as C1 |
| C4 | an `Acceptance` section whose every item has the same compared form as the title, as `R-CARD-33` defines it | `plan`, `once`, `run` | as C1 |
| C5 | a valid card beside it on the same board | `once`, `run` | the valid card is claimed and dispatched, so the fixture can tell a refusal from a stalled verb |

**Table E: the owner's turn.**

| # | Case | Required outcome |
|---|---|---|
| E1 | a kind whose judges end with `owner`, every agent judge sound at the head and digest | the card reaches the configured `owner` column |
| E2 | as E1 | the record holds no `review.escalate` for the card |
| E3 | as E1, then `report` over the stream | `report`'s escalation count for the run leaves the card out |
| E4 | on the same fixture, a card escalated by a judge's `critical` verdict | `report`'s escalation count includes that card, so the count discriminates |

**Edges ruled at filing.**

- **In sight:** Table C's four refusal shapes through the verbs named; Table E's four rows.
- **Out of sight:** a card whose acceptance is removed or broken after it was admitted and work began. Ruled in [M8-K5](https://github.com/williacj/rigger/issues/1293#issuecomment-6731270738) (E5): `R-CARD-1` reads "before any work on it starts", and later changes are `R-CARD-5` and `R-CARD-6`'s ground (M8-06b and M8-06c).

## Acceptance

- For each of Table C's rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `plan` and asserts `plan`'s output holds no pull line for the card, and names it with the refusal reason.
- For each of rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `once` and asserts the record holds no `pull` event for the card, and the board shows no move of the card out of Ready.
- For each of rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `once` and asserts no worktree was made for the card.
- For each of rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `once` and asserts the record holds no `dispatch.start` for the card.
- For each of rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `run` until the board drains and asserts the record holds no `pull` event for the card, and the board shows no move of the card out of Ready.
- For each of rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `run` until the board drains and asserts no worktree was made for the card.
- For each of rows C1 to C4, a test at the head, declaring `// proves R-CARD-1`, runs `run` until the board drains and asserts the record holds no `dispatch.start` for the card.
- A test at the head shows row C5: on the board holding the refused card, the valid card is claimed and dispatched by `once` and by `run`.
- A test at the head, declaring `// proves R-ESCALATE-5`, passes for row E1 of Table E.
- A test at the head, declaring `// proves R-ESCALATE-5`, passes for row E2.
- A test at the head, declaring `// proves R-ESCALATE-5`, passes for row E3.
- A test at the head, declaring `// proves R-ESCALATE-5`, passes for row E4.
- Each new test passing at the merge base is named in a quoted guarded mutation, with killed `npm run mutation:receipt` output, whose mutation turns it red; one receipt may cover several tests.
- Every new test that drives `once`, `run` or `loop`, or times anything, injects `manualClock`, and `npm test` exits 0 at the proposed head, #1137's guard included.
- `npm run matrix:check` exits 0 at the head, and `docs/derived/test-matrix.md` at the head names a test for each of `R-CARD-1` and `R-ESCALATE-5`.
- `git diff` against the merge base changes no existing line under `test/`.
- `git diff --name-only` against the merge base of the proposed head with `main` lists only this card's "Lands in" paths.
- The pull request body names each Self-hosting path the diff touches, or says it touches none.
- The committed journal entry says, for each row of Tables C and E, whether it held at the merge base or needed a change.
